additional_context: Claim is active in source/fhir.ini, making source/claim/structuredefinition-Claim.xml current build-scope source. FHIR-55203 later asked to make Claim.insurance.identifier repeating, and FM resolved it as Not Persuasive/Resolved - No Change, confirming the current 0..1 cardinality. Zulip discussion of secondary claims aligns with the COB rationale; Confluence searches found no conflicting meeting record.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current source already implements the requested element and examples demonstrate its use.
